extraction_notes: The supplied PDF is a shared BAW56, BAV70, and BAV99 family datasheet; the BAW56 target is explicitly named in the title and function/marking information, and the family electrical-characteristics rows and plots were used.

All numeric values are converted to SI units. The forward, reverse, and capacitance curve points are direct manual digitizations from the visible vector plots on p. 2; no points were interpolated. Reverse-current curve values are positive magnitudes as plotted.

The p. 2 electrical-characteristics table gives maximum instantaneous forward voltage at IF = 1 mA, 10 mA, 50 mA, and 150 mA; maximum reverse leakage at VR = 70 V; maximum total capacitance at VR = 0 V and f = 1 MHz; and maximum reverse recovery time under IF = IR = 10 mA, Irr = 0.1 x IR, and RL = 100 ohm.
The reverse breakdown voltage minimum of 70 V is specified at IR = 100 microA; the breakdown current field records that defining test current paired with the voltage.

Absolute maximum ratings include VRRM = 70 V, VR = 70 V, IF(AV) = 200 mA, IFM = 400 mA, IFSM = 2.0 A at tp = 1.0 ms, and Pd = 225 mW, all at Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise specified. Junction and storage temperature limits are -55 to +150 degC.

The power-dissipation-versus-ambient-temperature plot was not assigned a diode electrical curve because it is a thermal derating plot rather than a forward, reverse, capacitance, or recovery characteristic.
